maddeler.e:
يتعرقبوا (form IIq)
# يَتَعَرْقَبُوا (yataʕarqabū) /ja.ta.ʕar.qa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# يُتَعَرْقَبُوا (yutaʕarqabū) /ju.ta.ʕar.qa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
